label: For "Vendor Credential Compliance Risk Scoring": Identify vendor representatives whose required credentials, training, insurance or attestations are missing, expired or inconsistent, and give access staff an evidence-linked risk score and eligibility recommendation. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Scoring on records already remediated.
